name: bot-mtg-new
description: Capital.com SDD-M15 scanner with Angular dashboard (one web dyno).

TZ.description: Timezone for the M15 scheduler and Warsaw 21:00 PP roll.

BROKER.description: SPI adapter: capital (default live) or paper (in-process stub).

EXECUTION_ENABLED.description: false = scan + dashboard + webhooks only. true = may place orders.

CAPITAL_LIVE.description: true to use the live host and LIVE account gates.

AGENT_SIGNAL_WEBHOOK_URLS.description: Comma-separated URLs. JSON posted on new full stack or skip-worthy HA flip.
